svg.title: post-provision pipeline: sequence
svg.desc: Sequence of the post-provision pipeline between post-provision, Hub API, Spoke API, Keycloak, AWS, PrivateBin, Git. load-config: post-provision to Hub API: get ConfigMap fleet-pipeline-config; Hub API to post-provision: pipeline parameters. git-clone: post-provision to Git: clone the fleet repository; Git to post-provision: workloads/ in the workspace. extract-spoke-kubeconfig: post-provision to Hub API: read the admin kubeconfig Secret named by the ClusterDeployment; Hub API to post-provision: kubeconfig in the workspace. save-spoke-kubeconfig: post-provision to Hub API: write Secret NAME-spoke-kubeconfig. create-cluster-cronjob: post-provision to Hub API: apply CronJob NAME in namespace default. register-keycloak-client (runs when openshift-cluster is true): post-provision to Hub API: read the Keycloak admin Secret; post-provision to Keycloak: create or update the OIDC client of the cluster; post-provision to Hub API: write the client ID and secret to a hub Secret. configure-spoke-oauth (runs when openshift-cluster is true): post-provision to Hub API: read the OIDC client Secret; post-provision to Spoke API: apply the OIDC client Secret, the htpasswd Secret and the OAuth CR. create-cluster-issuer (runs when openshift-cluster is true): post-provision to Hub API: copy the cluster's AWS key into a Secret for cert-manager; post-provision to Hub API: create ClusterIssuer letsencrypt-NAME. request-ssl-cert (runs when openshift-cluster is true): post-provision to Hub API: create Certificate NAME-wildcard-certificate. wait-for-ssl-ready (runs when openshift-cluster is true): post-provision to Hub API: wait for condition Ready on the Certificate, timeout 20m; Hub API to AWS: cert-manager writes the DNS-01 records to Route53; Hub API to post-provision: Certificate Ready. extract-cert-material (runs when openshift-cluster is true): post-provision to Hub API: copy tls.crt and tls.key into Secret NAME-leaf-cert. configure-spoke-default-cert (runs when openshift-cluster is true): post-provision to Hub API: read Secret NAME-leaf-cert; post-provision to Spoke API: apply the Secret in openshift-ingress, patch the default IngressController. apply-base-workloads (runs when tier is base, virt, ai or coco): post-provision to Spoke API: apply the output of kustomize build workloads/base. apply-virt-workloads (runs when tier is virt): post-provision to Spoke API: install Node Feature Discovery, then OpenShift Virtualization. add-baremetal-workers (runs when tier is virt): post-provision to Hub API: create a bare-metal worker MachinePool. apply-ai-workloads (runs when tier is ai): post-provision to Spoke API: install the OpenShift AI 2.x or 3.x operators, and the GPU operators for nvidia-gpu. add-ai-workers (runs when tier is ai and ai-accelerator is nvidia-gpu): post-provision to Hub API: create a GPU worker MachinePool. prepare-podvm-aws (runs when tier is coco): post-provision to Spoke API: read the first worker node; post-provision to AWS: read its VPC, subnet and security groups, open the pod VM ports. build-podvm-image-aws (runs when tier is coco): post-provision to Spoke API: read the pod VM disk image of the operator; post-provision to AWS: reuse or build the pod VM AMI of the cluster, timeout 2h; AWS to post-provision: AMI ID. apply-coco-workloads (runs when tier is coco): post-provision to Spoke API: write peer-pods-secret and the peer pods configuration; post-provision to Spoke API: install sandboxed containers and the KataConfig, timeout 2h. configure-spoke-rbac (runs when openshift-cluster is true): post-provision to Spoke API: create group cluster-admins and its ClusterRoleBinding to cluster-admin. create-access-paste (runs when openshift-cluster is true): post-provision to Hub API: read the kubeadmin password; post-provision to PrivateBin: upload console URL, kubeadmin password and kubeconfig; post-provision to Hub API: store the paste URL and its password in a Secret. finalize-spoke (runs when openshift-cluster is true): post-provision to Spoke API: delete leftover installer pods and the kubeadmin Secret. Constraints: Trigger: trigger-post-provision of the provision pipeline creates the PipelineRun. Order: tasks are shown in an order the pipeline allows; the task flowchart shows which tasks run in parallel. openshift-cluster: false in a vCluster test run; the tasks marked openshift-cluster is true are then skipped. Tier: every tier applies the base overlay; the virt, ai or coco tasks run for a cluster of that tier. Timeout: 5h for the whole run.
